description_excerpt: Job Description • Support team working with customer to prepare & declare customs entry for inbound and outbound customs clearance. • Support team doing customs entry filing, physical inspection, customs liquidation at terminal (if request). • Fully understand and properly monitor all operational aspects of the Customs Brokerage department. This includes ensuring internal metrics, external KPIs, and operational process standards are met. • Set the standard for outstanding customer service and ensure that all client expectations are met according to the KPIs outlined in customer Standard…
